messages:
maya: FYI partner-ops pinged about small per-device rounding adding up on monthly invoices — they see ~0.01-0.03 units drift per device per hour, ends up ~2-3% overage on big fleets.
aj: ugh. Do we have a repro payload + sample invoice numbers?
maya: yes, asked for logs. Partner sent this example (redacted):
```json
{
  "account_id": "acct_XXXX",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-10T15:12:00Z",
  "usage_seconds": 0.48,
  "units": 0.008,
  "rate_plan": "marketplace_hourly_v2"
}
```
They say our billing shows 0.01 unit billed for that event.
suresh: my guess: partner sends fractional seconds/minutes, we normalize to minutes and then multiply by rate which rounds up to 2 decimal places before summing. floating point + rounding order bug.
oliver: marketplace contract expects usage in seconds and says meter provider should aggregate in microseconds to avoid rounding drift. IIRC the marketplace schema doc for AWS/GC/AM lists seconds with 6 decimals.
maya: partner claims they send with 3 decimals; if we treat 0.48 sec as 0.48 MIN that's huge. Need to confirm units mismatch too.
aj: can we reproduce quickly? put a small harness to feed both interpretations (seconds vs minutes) and compare monthly totals. I'll spin up a test with 10k simulated devices.
suresh: short-term mitigation: when parsing partner payloads, convert to integer micro-units (units * 1e6) and keep integer arithmetic until final billing rounding. That avoids incremental float rounding.
emily: operational question: do we need a billing-safe backfill if discrepancy > 1% for a partner? partner wants credits if we rolled them incorrectly.
oliver: yes, acceptance: identify impacted accounts, compute diff, and apply credits where necessary. But we need legal signoff on credit amounts. cc @billing-ops.
aj: I'll open PR to parse usage into nano-units and change aggregator to store integers. Plan: branch + unit tests today, staging deploy Wed, canary Fri.
maya: timeline sounds good. Also request partner to switch to 6-decimal seconds in webhook; add schema validation so we reject ambiguous payloads (unit field required).
suresh: regression tests I'll add: cases where 0.333333 sec * rate X yields expected total after integer aggregation. Will also include snapshot test comparing old vs new sums.
partner-delta-bot: Created ticket PD-9873: "marketplace usage rounding discrepancy - partner acct_XXXX" — assigned to @aj, priority: P2.
emily: owner for partner comms? I can draft the note explaining root cause and mitigation plan, and offer credit window.
maya: please loop in partner-account-team and legal. Acceptance criteria: 1) parser enforces units field, 2) integer internal storage, 3) backfill script + credit calc, 4) partner schema updated and tested.
aj: noted. I'll post PR link + canary plan in PD-9873.
suresh: one more thing — add metric to billing dashboard: "monthly rounding drift" per partner so we detect similar issues proactively.
maya: love that. thanks all. :raised_hands:
